description.name: Attach Earth with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Earth Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Earth 3

description.name: Arcane Dyad Empowered: Cinque
description.text: Keeps track of the number of uses of Apex Homerun Swing (0~2), removed after using Apex Homerun Swing two times

description.name: Apex Homerun Swing Damage Tracker
description.text: Increases Apex Homerun Swing level by 1 after dealing 100001 or 300001 total damage during the status, removed if the character hasn't [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Cinque]

description.name: Apex Homerun Swing Level
description.text: Keeps track of Apex Homerun Swing level (0~2), removed if the character hasn't [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Cinque]
